apparel_policy: 7-day no-reason returns and exchanges (tag intact and resale condition unaffected)
No reason-based returns or exchanges after the tag is removed unless there is a quality issue
If the size does not fit, apply for an exchange first
If out of stock, exchange for an in-stock item at the same price; any price difference is refunded or charged
food_policy: Shelf-stable food supports after-sales service for quality issues within the shelf life
For cold-chain and fresh items, only quality issues are eligible for after-sales service after receipt
Compensation is available under the rules for items that are near expiry, leaking or spoiled
Unclear allergen labeling can be escalated to a specialist
general_policy: Invoices support individual, corporate and VAT special invoices (subject to qualification)
Coupons and promotion rules are subject to the checkout page
Logistics abnormalities may be escalated to a specialist
